newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.03 pct in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.03 pct in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.03 percent to close at 1.0325 against the dollar in listless trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
"It was a rainy and dead Monday," one trader said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $70 million.
Dealers said they expect another day of calm trade on Tuesday.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0381 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.73 percent to close at 1.085 per greenback, traders said.
